entries.title: The Tweezerfest gets its audio
entries.notes: phish.in posted the 7/25 recording: 22 tracks aligned 1:1 — six Tweezers, two Down with Diseases — real durations replacing the live estimates, and four bustout tags with gap counts.

entries.title: Feeds backfilled with phish.in track maps + official photos
entries.notes: 7/21, 7/22 and 7/24 get audio links, real recorded durations, tags and banter.

entries.title: Retroactive show notes for the MSG retrospective nights
entries.notes: Curated notes and Phish.net links for the '92, '93 and '94 nights — preserved across bot rewrites.

entries.title: Live-only signal capture
entries.notes: Per-song first-seen clock times, setlist edit diffs, rating snapshots and venue weather — recorded during the show, because they're unrecoverable after. Poll cadence tightens to 30s once the show is live.

entries.title: Verified recap thread promoted to X
entries.notes: The next-morning phish.in lengths thread now posts to X as well.

entries.title: Phishpicks v2 payloads + 46 tests
entries.notes: Positions, incoming segue marks and receiver-aware retries; blind appends made impossible, and the test-post command guarded so a credentials check can never inject a phantom song.

entries.title: Every show auto-archives
entries.notes: Each night lands in docs/setlists/ with curated notes preserved across rewrites.

entries.title: Bot goes live
entries.notes: Polls Phish.net during shows, posts to Truth Social, publishes the site's live feed.
